#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

struct TaskF {
    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        vector<int> beauty(n);
        int totalBeauty = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            cin >> beauty[i];
            totalBeauty += beauty[i];
        }

        int half = n / 2;
        vector<int> charOccurrences(128, 0);
        vector<int> equalPairIndices(half);
        int equalCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
            if (s[i] == s[n - 1 - i]) {
                equalPairIndices[equalCount++] = i;
                charOccurrences[s[i]]++;
            }
        }

        char mostCommonChar = 'a';
        for (int c = 0; c < 128; ++c) {
            if (charOccurrences[c] > charOccurrences[mostCommonChar]) {
                mostCommonChar = (char)c;
            }
        }

        int ans = totalBeauty;
        for (int j = 0; j < equalCount; ++j) {
            int idx = equalPairIndices[j];
            ans -= min(beauty[idx], beauty[n - 1 - idx]);
        }

        if (charOccurrences[mostCommonChar] > equalCount / 2) {
            vector<int> penalties(half);
            int penaltyCount = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
                if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - i] && s[i] != mostCommonChar && s[n - 1 - i] != mostCommonChar) {
                    penalties[penaltyCount++] = min(beauty[i], beauty[n - 1 - i]);
                }
            }
            sort(penalties.begin(), penalties.begin() + penaltyCount);
            int rem = 2 * charOccurrences[mostCommonChar] - equalCount;
            for (int i = 0; i < rem; ++i) {
                ans -= penalties[i];
            }
        }

        cout << ans << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
